title: The Ocean ‘Was the Color of Chocolate.’ Mexico Declares War on Seaweed.
summary_full: To protect Mexico’s tourism-reliant economy, the Navy is fighting a massive sargassum bloom that dumps thousands of tons of seaweed onto Caribbean beaches daily.
